project_context: MomentumX internal day-trading app dashboard replacement. Dense, highly technical single-screen layout with real-time data flow. Pure .js files (no .tsx).

headings.usage: Panel titles, dashboard headers, alert headings.

data_and_numbers.font: JetBrains Mono, Roboto Mono, or standard monospace
data_and_numbers.usage: CRITICAL: All dynamic numeric data (Price, Volume, Change %, Float, Timestamps) MUST use a monospace font to prevent horizontal shifting.

visual_enhancers.borders_and_surfaces: Strictly cardless, flush grids. Use 1px solid borders (`border-[#262626]`) to divide panels. NO rounded corners on main panels (`rounded-none`). NO soft shadows or glow effects. Pure technical 'terminal' aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Subtle background lightening (`hover:bg-[#141414]`). Interactive rows in the scanner must have immediate background hover feedback.
visual_enhancers.color_grading: Row text or background tints should reflect % change intensity. Brighter neon green for high gain, dimmer green for lower gain.

grids_and_layouts.overall_structure: Dense, one-screen viewport (`h-screen`, `w-screen`, `overflow-hidden`). Everything must fit without global page scrolling.
grids_and_layouts.top_strip: Compact account/position summary (Portfolio Value, Buying Power, P&L, Open Positions). Height: `h-12` to `h-16`. Border bottom.
grids_and_layouts.main_workspace: CSS Grid or Flex layout occupying `calc(100vh - headerHeight)`.

panel_allocation.left_sidebar: width: 25-30%. Contains (1) Scanner Results Table (Top 60%), (2) 5/5 Ready-to-Trade Alerts (Bottom 40%).
panel_allocation.main_area: width: 70-75%. Contains (1) Selected Stock Quote & News Feed Strip at the top, (2) 2x2 Charting Grid taking up the remaining space.

grids_and_layouts.padding_strategy: Ultra-dense. Use `p-1`, `p-2`, or `p-3` inside panels. No wasted whitespace.

component_instructions.scanner_table: Dense data table. Columns: Time, Symbol, Price, Vol, Float, Chg%, RelVol. Rows must be clickable to set the 'Selected Symbol'. Include hot news indicator directly in the row.
component_instructions.news_indicator: Use flame emojis as badges: 🔴🔥 (breaking/hot), 🟠🔥 (warm), 🟡🔥 (cold/older). Render based on freshness tier.
component_instructions.alert_panel: Dedicated section for '5/5 Ready to Trade' triggers. High visual contrast, perhaps flashing or pulsing border for new alerts.
component_instructions.charting_grid: 2x2 grid for the selected symbol (10s, 1m, 5m, 1D). Each chart must be explicitly labeled. Overlays required: EMAs, VWAP, MACD, Volume. Use lightweight-charts (TradingView) or a robust financial chart library if possible. Render horizontal lines/markers for 'large trade block prints' as support/resistance.
component_instructions.news_feed: Scrolling or dense list of headlines for the currently selected symbol.
component_instructions.data_handling: CRITICAL: Charts and symbol-specific news MUST NOT auto-populate. They only load when a user clicks a row in the scanner. Display a 'Select a symbol from the scanner' empty state until clicked. ALL DATA must be wired to real endpoints (Alpaca/WebSocket) - no fabricated/demo data.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure black backgrounds with high-contrast neon text meet readability standards.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (scanner rows, timeframe toggles, buy/sell buttons) MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="scanner-row-AAPL"`).

universal_guidelines.transparent_backgrounds: CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content scrolling under it (like dropdowns). Always use a solid fill (e.g., `#0A0A0A`) or a heavy backdrop blur with an opacity overlay.
universal_guidelines.file_extensions: Use standard `.js` files for React components. Do not use `.tsx`.
universal_guidelines.animations: Do NOT apply universal transitions (`transition: all`). Apply fast, snappy transitions only to specific properties like `background-color` or `border-color` (e.g., `transition-colors duration-75`). In a trading app, speed > smoothness.
universal_guidelines.empty_states: Use minimalist technical empty states (e.g., 'AWAITING SYMBOL SELECTION_' with a blinking cursor block) rather than cute illustrations.
